name: Meteora

requiredConfig.name: Solana RPC endpoint
requiredConfig.description: Used by the MCP adapter to read DLMM pool and position accounts and refresh state at approval time.

requiredConfig.name: Meteora DLMM client
requiredConfig.description: Host process must wire the Meteora DLMM client factory backed by @meteora-ag/dlmm, or inject an equivalent client for tests.

readCapabilities.returns: DLMM pool snapshot with token mints, active bin, bin step, fee fields, liquidity, status flags, program id, and slot metadata.
Wallet-owned DLMM positions, optionally filtered to one pool, with bin ranges, liquidity, token amounts, fees, rewards, and in-range status.
One DLMM position with owner, pool, bin range, active-bin comparison, liquidity, token amounts, unclaimed fees, and rewards.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A manual-approval inbox item to claim swap fees for one DLMM position, or all positions in a pool when claimAll is true.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A freshly rebuilt Meteora DLMM claim-fees transaction.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A manual-approval inbox item to claim liquidity mining rewards for one DLMM position, or all positions in a pool when claimAll is true.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A freshly rebuilt Meteora DLMM claim-rewards transaction.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A manual-approval inbox item to add liquidity to an existing DLMM position with explicit token amounts, bin range, strategy, and slippage cap.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A freshly rebuilt Meteora DLMM add-liquidity transaction.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A manual-approval inbox item to remove a bounded percentage of liquidity from a DLMM position over a validated bin range.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A freshly rebuilt Meteora DLMM remove-liquidity transaction.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A manual-approval inbox item to close an empty DLMM position after the adapter confirms no liquidity remains.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A freshly rebuilt Meteora DLMM close-position transaction.

requiredUserInputs.name: poolAddress
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Which Meteora DLMM pool should I use?

requiredUserInputs.name: positionAddress
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Which Meteora DLMM position should I use?

requiredUserInputs.name: tokenXAmount or tokenYAmount
requiredUserInputs.prompt: What token X or token Y amount should I add?

requiredUserInputs.name: minBinId and maxBinId
requiredUserInputs.prompt: What bin range should I add liquidity across?

requiredUserInputs.name: liquidityPercent
requiredUserInputs.prompt: What percent of the Meteora liquidity should I remove?

requiredConnectorFacts: Current active bin and selected bin range
Position liquidity and whether the position is in range
Unclaimed fees and rewards before claim or close
Wallet token balances for both pool tokens
Slippage cap and strategy type for add/remove liquidity
unsupportedRequests: Create a brand-new Meteora DLMM position.
Prepare Meteora actions without a pool or required position address.
Close a position that still has liquidity.
Guarantee profitability, APY, or impermanent-loss safety.
Move funds without a wallet signature.
actionPreparationNotes: Meteora is first-class and prepare-only. Reads and prepared writes use the MCP adapter, store connectorId=meteora, refresh DLMM state at execution time, and reject missing pool/position/range/amount inputs. New position creation is intentionally not exposed because it requires an additional position keypair signer.
riskNotes: Meteora DLMM positions are sensitive to bin selection, active-bin movement, fees, rewards, slippage, transfer fees, and impermanent loss. Display pool and position facts before approval.
walletApprovalBoundary: The connector may read DLMM pool and position facts when configured. Writes create manual-approval inbox items only; the wallet signs and broadcasts separately after the adapter refreshes state.

needsInputQuestions: Which position address should I check?
Which DLMM pool is it in?
requests.agentResponse: The agent needs a pool and position address before it can read Meteora DLMM position facts.

needsInputQuestions: Which Meteora position should I read?
requests.agentResponse: Fee reads require a Meteora pool and position address.

requests.user: add liquidity to this Meteora pool
needsInputQuestions: Which existing position should receive liquidity?
What token amount should I add?
What bin range should I use?
requests.agentResponse: The agent is missing facts needed to prepare the approval item. Existing position, token amount, and bin range are required.

requests.user: add 1 SOL and 100 USDC to my Meteora position between bins 100 and 120
requests.agentResponse: Prepared a Meteora add-liquidity approval item after validating the position, pool, bin range, strategy, and slippage cap. This prepares wallet approval only; it does not sign.

requests.user: claim fees from my Meteora position
requests.agentResponse: Prepared a Meteora fee-claim approval item after checking the pool and position. The transaction is rebuilt when the wallet approves.

requests.user: remove 25 percent of my Meteora liquidity
requests.agentResponse: Prepared a Meteora remove-liquidity approval item for 25 percent of the position over its validated bin range.

requests.user: close my Meteora position without checking it
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because the position must be read and confirmed empty before close-position can be prepared.

requests.user: create a new Meteora DLMM position
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because new Meteora position creation is not exposed by the connector.

requests.user: guarantee this Meteora range is safe
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because it cannot guarantee safety, yield, or impermanent-loss outcomes.
The agent denied this because Meteora connector actions are only exposed for mainnet-beta.

requests.user: move my Meteora LP without opening my wallet
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because the connector cannot move funds without the user's wallet approval.

requests.user: what is the APY on this Meteora pool?
needsInputQuestions: Which pool address should I read?
requests.agentResponse: The agent needs a pool address before reading Meteora market facts. It can report available pool facts, but it cannot guarantee future APY.

mirrorsCanonical.note: Mirrors the first-class Meteora connector entry and MCP adapter under packages/mcp-server/src/adapters/meteora.
